title: "correlation"
format: docx

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
mydf <- read_csv("Newsela_SCA.csv")
```

```{r}
attach(mydf)

plot(MLS,MLT,main='Scatterplot of MLS and MLT',xlab='MLS',ylab='MLT')
abline(lm(MLS~MLT),col='red',lwd=2)
```

```{r}
attach(mydf)

shapiro.test(MLS)
shapiro.test(MLT)
```

```{r}
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
hist(MLS,main='Histogram
for
MLS',xlab='MLS')

hist(MLT,main='Histogram
for MLT',xlab='MLT')
```

```{r}
cor.test(MLS,MLT,
         alternative = "two.sided",
         method = "spearman")
```

A Spearman’s rank-order correlation was conducted to examine the relationship between MLS and MLT. The analysis revealed a very strong positive correlation between the two variables, rs=.987, p\<.001, indicating that higher MLS values were strongly associated with higher MLT values.
